As Sanofi (SNY) Stock Declined, Provise Management Group Has Upped by $373,800 Its Position; First Long Island Investors Upped Holding in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by $5.67 Million
June 11, 2018 - By reb123z
First Long Island Investors Llc increased its stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by 875.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Long Island Investors Llc bought 51,979 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.83% with the market. The hedge fund held 57,917 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.37M, up from 5,938 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Long Island Investors Llc who had been investing in Jpmorgan Chase & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $378.25B market cap company. The stock increased 0.28% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $111.11. About 10.38 million shares traded. JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) has risen 29.65% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.08% the S&P500.
